description: A fictional slope slide board game prop for riding sand pours and rubble slopes, chunky low-poly, shown alone, lying level on the ground with the nose forward. One short wide sand-grey painted shell board with wide chamfered edges: a flat middle, a nose that curves gently up at the front (about 0.05 m rise) ending in a thick charcoal bumper block, and a tail that curves up slightly at the back. One thick charcoal grip mat sunk into the centre of the deck with exactly six wide ribs running along it. Exactly two wide arched charcoal foot straps, each with one big rectangular dark steel buckle, cross the deck from rail to rail at an angle, one in the front half and one in the middle-rear, each arching about 0.06 m above the deck. One thick charcoal bumper strip along each side rail. Exactly two fat dark steel D-shaped carry clips stand up from the deck near the tail, one each side of the centre line. One small teal lamp window in a thick charcoal bezel on the left rail near the nose. The underside is a flat dark steel skid plate.
proportions: About 1 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.16 m tall. (length : width : height = 2.50 : 1 : 0.40)
sides: the board is mirror-symmetric left to right: the two foot straps run across the deck, the clips are one each side of the centre line, the bumper strips are on both rails. The only left-right difference is the small teal lamp window, on the left rail only (flush).
